lastCompletedStory.title: Pin the both-streams-empty contract through runPlanPreflight and real truncatePreflightDetail

nextStoryContext: US-003 closed the last gap in the CAM-363 stderr-drop contract chain: the both-streams-empty case, which is the original symptom shape (a failing step whose narration renders with NO verdict). Two assertions were added to test/supervisor/plan/plan-preflight.test.ts, no source files changed: (1) AC6b -- the existing first-fail-only 'does not call git pull when checkout fails' test (fed `{ exitCode: 1, stdout: '', stderr: '' }` as its sole, non-fallback-derived response) now additionally captures `result` and asserts `result.ok === false` and `result.detail === ''` strictly, alongside the pre-existing `calls.length` assertion; the response array had exactly one element consumed at idx 0, so the empty detail is proven to come from the explicit failing response, not the fake's default-fill fallback (`{ exitCode: 0, stdout: '', stderr: '' }` returned when the array is exhausted) -- avoiding the FAKE-FALLBACK GOTCHA the story notes called out. (2) AC6c -- a new `describe('truncatePreflightDetail', ...)` block asserts `truncatePreflightDetail('') === ''` using the REAL function imported from src/supervisor/plan-preflight-marker.ts (already imported at the top of the file for the pre-existing AC7 assertions), not a reimplementation; this exercises truncatePreflightDetail's early-return branch (`if (rest.length === 0) return detail;`, since ''.split('\n') yields ['']  with rest empty). All three levels of the contract (combineStreams helper, runPlanPreflight result, truncatePreflightDetail) are now pinned for the both-empty case in one file. Full bun test: 5190 pass / 0 fail (up from the 5179 main baseline the AC13 oracle checks against; net +11 declared test cases, all additive, none removed). check:all spine fully green (test, embed-vendor, lint, file-size, debt-markers, version-skips, coverage, dead-code, dup, ci-parity, agents-md, test-sleeps); the 'push rejected'/'suggestions.jsonl missing on main' lines and the biome.json deprecated-'recommended'-field info and knip config-hints are pre-existing harness/repo self-checks unrelated to this story's diff, not regressions introduced here.
